  coords9=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(input_rows) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==9]

  # compact non-background pattern and border coordinate columns/rows by frequency

  ctr=Counter(v for row in input_rows for v in row)
  print(' colors',dict(ctr))
  print(' 8 coords',coords8[:10], '...' if len(coords8)>10 else '')
